name: global-search-attribution

modules.label: Modules to search
modules.description: Comma-separated module keys to fan each query out to (e.g. "contacts,projects,invoices"). Each key gets one scoped MODULE_SEARCH_REQUESTED; the module owning a key subscribes to it and answers with SEARCH_RESULTS. Empty = no fan-out (the query is still persisted to history).
